Paper Statements

The statements journals now require: data and code availability, author contributions (CRediT), funding, conflicts and ethics, plus a reproducibility checklist.

What it adds

  • Snippet: Data availability statement
  • Snippet: Code availability statement
  • Snippet: Author contributions (CRediT)
  • Snippet: Funding statement
  • Snippet: Competing interests
  • Snippet: Ethics statement
  • Snippet: Reproducibility checklist
